title: H175 — PEAD-NLP: 8-K Section Extraction via sec-parser + EPS Surprise Dual Gate
rationale: arXiv 2509.24254 (Sep 2025, 138k press releases) shows FinBERT on earnings press release structure is 'equally informative as earnings surprise' for announcement-day returns. Our H163 uses full 8-K text; extracting only Item 2.02 (Results of Operations) with sec-parser may reduce noise and improve signal purity. Additionally, adding standardized EPS surprise (actual - consensus) / std as a second numeric gate (alongside FinBERT) could lift H174's 6.22% MeanRet. sec-parser (alphanome-ai/sec-parser, MIT) extracts 8-K sections into semantic tree — no API key required.
content:
New hypothesis:

H175 — PEAD-NLP: sec-parser Item 2.02 extraction + EPS surprise numeric gate

Design:
  1. Use sec-parser to extract Item 2.02 text only from 8-K (vs full text in H163)
  2. Score extracted section with FinBERT (same H163 model)
  3. Also compute standardized EPS surprise: (actual_EPS - estimate_EPS) / std_EPS
     via yfinance EPS data (earnings_history) or Polygon.io
  4. Dual filter: finbert_score >= 0.18 AND eps_surprise_std >= 0.5
  5. Compare OOS vs H163/H174 baselines

Install: pip install sec-parser
Code pattern:
  from sec_parser import SemanticTree, TreeBuilder
  builder = TreeBuilder()
  tree = builder.build(html_text)
  item_202 = [n for n in tree.nodes if '2.02' in str(n.title)]

Confirm criteria: OOS WR >= 68%, MeanRet >= 5.5%, n >= 15
Estimated effort: 4h
